messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx gateway errors and connection timeouts for private VPC customer 'acme-health' (region: us-west-2). Error rate +? 5xx: 18% -> 42% in last 3m. Paging oncall.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Paging Maya Chen (oncall). Escalation level: page -> sms -> call.
Maya Chen: on it. joining.
Sam Patel: saw the alert. Any customer reports yet? logs show a mix of 502/504 and TLS handshake timeouts.
Maya Chen: Customer SRE (AcmeHealth) pinged support slack: they're seeing app errors and retries. Putting them in a shared zoom.
Leo Morales: I'm looking at the gateway metrics (gw-proxy-priv-*/alb). 5xx and downstream timeouts align with NAT/gw egress spikes. KPIs: increased SYN retransmits on egress.
Priya Rao: running quick tcpdump on a troubled instance: `sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-ack) != 0'` showing SYNs leaving but no SYN-ACKs back from peer.
Maya Chen: can you traceroute to the customer endpoint from a failing pod? traceroute shows hang at peering-vpc-router hop.
Sam Patel: checking VPC peering metrics in cloud console: TTL counters show a sudden route flap at 14:02 UTC. Route table unchanged.
Infra-SRE: any recent security group or firewall churn? I see a deploy tagged "security/ephemeral-sg-tightening" at 13:55 UTC in terraform-runbook.
Leo Morales: that patch tightened inbound ephemeral port ranges on the egress-facing SG for the peering-facing bastion. I think ephemeral ports got restricted to 49160-49170 only.
Maya Chen: oh no. Peering egress needs full ephemeral range. That would drop return traffic and cause gateway timeouts. Can someone confirm SG rules? paste incoming rule:

```
SecurityGroup sg-0a1b2c3d
Inbound:
  - Protocol: TCP
    Ports: 443
    Source: 10.0.0.0/16
  - Protocol: TCP
    Ports: 49160-49170
    Source: 10.0.0.0/16
```

Maya Chen: That explains missing SYN-ACKs for most connections.
Priya Rao: confirmed on host: `sudo conntrack -S` shows conntrack drops increasing rapidly. `dmesg` shows "NETFILTER: dropped packet from 10.2.5.6: ephemeral port denied".
Sam Patel: immediate mitigation: expand SG inbound ephemeral ports to full ephemeral range (32768-60999) for peering subrange, or temporarily open all ephemeral ports from peered VPC. Which is faster?
Leo Morales: fastest is a targeted rule: allow 1024-65535 from peered VPC cidr. I'll patch via cloud console now and follow with IaC rollback after.
Maya Chen: go for it. Apply and confirm connectivity.
Leo Morales: applying rule now via console: adding inbound TCP 1024-65535 from 10.50.0.0/16 to sg-0a1b2c3d. ETA ~30s.
Maya Chen: standing by.
(30s)
Leo Morales: new rule in place. Observability: 5xx rate starting to drop.
Priya Rao: tcpdump shows SYN->SYN-ACK now, conntrack stable.
Maya Chen: can folks watch upstream latency/5xx for next 10m and report.
Sam Patel: metrics look good: 5xx down to 6% in 2m, errors continue to decline. Customer on call reports their app recovered.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged resolved for paging rule; keep channel open for RCA.
Maya Chen: quick impact notes for incident channel: Incident start 14:01 UTC, root cause: security-group rollback/overly restrictive ephemeral port rollout at 13:55 UTC, effect: 18-42% 5xx and TLS/timeouts for acme-health private VPC egress, affected duration ~14:01-14:10 (mitigated at 14:03–14:04 with rule); number of failed requests ~12k (estimate from logs), sustained error window ~9m for some flows.
Leo Morales: created Jira INC-3421 and attached timeline + sg diff. Will run IaC revert and a safer rule in staging.
Priya Rao: follow-ups: 1) revert the terraform change so console + IaC consistent, 2) add automated test in PR pipeline to ensure ephemeral port ranges not narrowed below 1024, 3) run traffic replays to validate.
Sam Patel: notifying product/CS for customer-facing note. Sending initial message to account team now.
Maya Chen: handing off monitoring to Priya (next oncall) for night watch. Priya, take it, I'll be on-call if we need escalation.
Priya Rao: taking over. I'll keep the channel updated and run through RCA checklist now.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation. Postmortem to be written in 48h. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=page, ticket=INC-3421, runbook=security-sg-ephemeral. Next steps: postmortem + IaC revert.
